subject.title: fix(canvas): stop sending undefined coords on partial placement

question: Should `canvas.present` accept partial placement coordinates, and if so, what node-visible semantics should omitted coordinates have?
rationale: The patch removes undefined properties but does not establish whether omitted coordinates are valid, defaulted, or rejected; that contract determines whether any code change is needed.

options.title: Preserve current partial semantics
options.body: If omitted coordinates are intentionally optional, close this no-op rewrite and document or test the supported partial payload behavior.

options.title: Require complete placement
options.body: Reject partial coordinate sets before invoking the node and add a focused regression test plus real node-output proof.

options.title: Define defaults for omissions
options.body: Supply explicit defaults at the Canvas boundary and prove the node receives the fully resolved placement.

recommendation.title: Preserve current partial semantics
recommendation.body: If omitted coordinates are intentionally optional, close this no-op rewrite and document or test the supported partial payload behavior.

likelyOwner.person: Canvas extension owner (unidentified from available review context)
